# Reglet

> .NET 10 library that creates, reads and converts DOCX, ODT, PDF and HTML documents from one format-neutral model, with no dependencies beyond the base class library.

- Install: `dotnet add package Reglet` (facade). `Reglet.Core`, `Reglet.Docx`, `Reglet.Odt`, `Reglet.Pdf`, `Reglet.Html`, `Reglet.Fonts` and `Reglet.Hyphenation` can be used on their own. `Reglet.Xlsx` writes and reads Excel workbooks. `Reglet.Validation` validates files. `Reglet.Mcp` is an MCP server (`reglet-mcp`) for agents.
- Build a document with `PortableDocument.Create()`, write it with `DocumentWriter.WriteAsync(document, "out.pdf")` (format from the extension), read one with `DocumentReader`.
- Documents are immutable; all lengths are stored in points (`Length`).
- Unicode text in PDF needs caller-provided TrueType fonts (`PdfWriteOptions.FontCollection`).
- Drawn pages (data sheets, labels): `PdfCanvas` draws text, lines, rectangles and images at fixed coordinates (points, origin top left, y down); `MeasureText` returns the drawn width.
- Migrating from MigraDoc: fields and empty paragraphs take their paragraph's font size; `ImageBlock.TakesAnchorLine = false` floats an image without an empty anchor line; `TableBlock.CellPaddingHorizontal`/`CellPaddingVertical` and `LeftIndent` give MigraDoc's 1.2 mm side padding with the text at the margin. Further: `TableRow.KeepTogether` (MigraDoc never splits a row), `InlineImage` for a picture in a paragraph's line, `TableBlock.FixedColumnWidths`, `TableBlock.ColumnWidthPercents` (columns in percent of the table, resolved against the section text width), `Section.HeaderDistance`/`HeaderPushesBody = false`, `PdfWriteOptions.Kerning`/`Ligatures = false` (PDFsharp sets text unkerned).
- Excel workbooks (`Reglet.Xlsx`, ADR-0043): a separate, mutable model in Core (`Workbook.AddWorksheet(name)` checks Excel's name rules; `sheet.Cell("B3").Value = 5`, `.Formula = "SUM(A1:A3)"`, `.Style = style with { NumberFormat = "#,##0.00" }`; `Merge`, `SetStyle`, `SetOutsideBorder`, `ColumnWidths`, `RowHeights`, `Images`, `PageSetup`). `XlsxWorkbookWriter.WriteAsync` writes it (formulas without cached values, recalculated by Excel on open); `XlsxWorkbookReader.Read` reads one back; `WorksheetCell.GetFormattedText(culture)` gives the text Excel shows; `WorksheetCell.Evaluate()` calculates references, SUM, PRODUCT and arithmetic for tests (anything else: `FormulaException`). `ColumnWidths` are widths as Excel shows them. No full calculation engine.
- Validating a file (`Reglet.Validation`, ADR-0044): `new DocumentValidator().Validate(stream)` returns a `ValidationReport` (`Format`, `IsValid`, `Issues` with `Severity`, `Part`, `Line`, `Message`). DOCX/XLSX: package, content types, relationships, ECMA-376 Transitional schemas after markup compatibility (Office 2010+ extensions understood, not schema-checked); ODF: mimetype and manifest, ODF 1.3/1.4 RELAX NG schemas (own validator; foreign markup such as loext removed first); PDF: header, %%EOF, strict cross-references, trailer and catalog, stream lengths, page tree, page boxes, content operators and BT/ET, q/Q balance, fonts, annotations. No PDF/A rules (use veraPDF).
- MCP server (ADR-0045): `dotnet tool install -g Reglet.Mcp`; run `reglet-mcp --root <dir>` (stdio). Tools: `create_document` (Markdown → DOCX/ODT/PDF/HTML), `convert_document`, `read_document`, `fill_template` (`{{Name}}`), `validate_file`, `create_workbook`, `read_workbook`, `merge_pdfs`, `extract_pdf_pages`. Paths stay inside the roots; `overwrite: true` replaces a file.
- A preview that looks like the PDF: `PdfDocumentWriter.WriteHtmlAsync` (or `PdfCanvas.WriteHtmlAsync`) writes the PDF's pages as HTML; `PdfHtmlOptions` selects a full document or a fragment with a class prefix. The flow HTML of `DocumentWriter` with `.html` is simple and editable, not page-faithful.
